rationale.conceptual: The method involves an established but non-trivial MD protocol: setting up a united-atom force field, designing equilibration and cooling ramps, and using reduced-volume piecewise fitting to determine Tg. This requires careful implementation of multiple components (force field, thermostat/barostat, orthogonal distance regression) and domain-specific understanding of polymer physics – not a textbook one-liner but not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of at least five stages: generating initial chain conformations (self-avoiding walk), energy minimisation, thermal annealing, NPT equilibration (5 ns), cooling production run (15 ns), parsing simulation logs, and performing piecewise linear regression on reduced volume. Each stage relies on correct LAMMPS scripting and post-processing, making the orchestration moderately complex (4–6 interdependent steps). No heavy tooling or data acquisition beyond LAMMPS and Python, but non-trivial handoffs exist.
